homeTitle: Meowly | An everyday alarm with a feline twist
homeDescription: Meowly is an iPhone alarm with a feline twist. Set single alarms, build alarm sequences, and give your reminders a sound of their own.
heroIntro: From the first wake-up call to the last reminder before bed, Meowly lets you plan your day and give each alarm a little personality.
previewAlt: Example Meowly alarm screen with morning, hydration, and bedtime reminders
featureIntro: Start with one alarm or set up a whole sequence at once.
singleBody: Set a wake-up alarm or choose which days it repeats each week to stay on top of your routine.
batchBody: Create alarms at regular intervals or set each time yourself to build a sequence that fits your day.
customBody: Name each alarm and give it an icon and color so you can spot a water break, rest, or an important event at a glance.
soundBody: Try three built-in Meowly sounds, from gentle to lively. Meowly Pro lets you set them as alarm sounds or import an audio file of your own.
soundError: The sound couldn't play. Please try again.
iphoneBody: Requires iOS 18 or later. Meowly uses system alarms on iOS 26 and later and local notifications on earlier versions.
privacyDescription: This policy explains how the Meowly iPhone app and this website handle data, and how you can manage permissions and delete your data.
deviceBody: Meowly stores alarm times, repeat schedules, labels, groups, sound choices, and appearance preferences on your device. It uses them to schedule reminders, display your alarms, and apply your settings.
audioBody: When you import a custom sound, Meowly reads the audio file you select in the iOS file picker. It converts and stores a copy on your device along with details such as the file name and duration, so you can preview it and use it for reminders.
permissionsBody: Meowly asks iOS for the relevant alarm or notification permission when it needs to schedule a reminder. You can manage or revoke these permissions in iOS Settings. Turning them off may prevent reminders from sounding or appearing.
sharingBody: Meowly requires no account. The app does not send alarm data, preferences, or imported audio to the Meowly developer. It does not use third-party advertising, analytics, or tracking tools.
appleBody: iOS schedules and delivers reminders on your device. If you use Apple backups or other Apple services, Apple handles data for those services under its own policy.
retentionBody: Alarms and preferences stay on your device. You can delete alarms or remove the custom sound in the app. Delete the app to remove its local data from your device. Deleting the app does not delete the original audio file or existing device backups.
websiteBody: This website uses no analytics or advertising trackers and sets no cookies to remember your language. Choosing a language opens its own URL. The hosting provider may process IP addresses and request information to serve pages and keep the service secure.
contactBody: If you have questions about this policy or how your data is handled, contact the developer through the support channel listed with Meowly's app listing.
